That sounds like you're making good progress with the classification. The title variants you're noting are common in Daoist texts—scholars often use shortened forms or slight rephrasings when citing from indexes like Pregadio's. For instance, the "太上说" vs. "灵宝天尊说" in DZ 317 and 43 is a frequent shorthand, and the same goes for the "后编" vs. "后集" in DZ 298.

corrections.title: 太上洞玄灵宝三元威仪自然经
corrections.note: Schipper/CT title: 洞玄靈寶玉籙簡文三元威儀自然真經 (DZ530). DZ526 is the Daozang tiyao (DT) number, not the Schipper DZ number; DZ526 is 太上洞淵三昧神咒齋清旦行道儀.

corrections.title: 太上灵宝净明法序
corrections.note: CRTA/Zhonghua Daozang index: 太上靈寶淨明法序 = DZ559 (Pregadio lists related 法印式 at CT559; DT≈554). DZ554 is 靈寶淨明院教師周真公起請畫一.

corrections.title: 还丹众仙论
corrections.note: 還丹眾仙論 is DZ233 (Yang Zai 楊在). DZ232 is 還丹祕訣養赤子神方; 232 is the DT number for 還丹眾仙論.

corrections.title: 玄宗直指万法同归
corrections.note: 玄宗直指萬法同歸 is DZ1066 (CT1066; DT1055). DZ1055 is 純陽真人渾成集.

corrections.title: 灵棋经
corrections.note: Full Schipper title 靈棋本章正經 = DZ1041 (DT1032). DZ1032 is 雲笈七籤.

corrections.title: 道德真经取善集
corrections.note: 道德真經取善集 (Li Lin 李霖) is DZ718 (DT713). DZ713 is 道德經論兵要義述.
